multi_label_policy.primary_rule: Comments should primarily receive one primary category. A second category may be assigned only when a comment genuinely and substantially addresses distinct technical domains (e.g., both testing methodology and database concurrency).
multi_label_policy.noise_rule: Non-technical comments, pure acknowledgments, or comments without technical feedback must receive 'non_technical' or 'insufficient_context' status rather than artificial expertise labels.

categories.name: Architecture & Software Design
categories.definition: Feedback regarding module decoupling, design patterns, interface boundaries, component responsibilities, dependency injection, and overall code structure.
inclusion_criteria: Discussions of interface/class hierarchy design
Encapsulation, coupling, and modularity suggestions
Refactoring to design patterns (e.g. factory, adapter, observer)
API contract structuring and domain model organization
exclusion_criteria: Minor syntax or variable renames without structural change (Code Style)
Database schema migrations without architectural redesign (Data Management)
examples: We should decouple this payment provider behind an interface rather than referencing the concrete class.
Consider splitting this 500-line controller into focused domain service handlers.

categories.name: Testing & Quality Assurance
categories.definition: Feedback concerning automated unit tests, integration tests, mock fixtures, edge cases, regression coverage, CI test assertions, and test harness setup.
inclusion_criteria: Requests to add unit, integration, or regression tests
Feedback on assertions, test fixtures, mock objects, or test flakiness
Boundary condition and edge-case testing coverage
exclusion_criteria: CI/CD pipeline workflow YAML config without test logic (Infrastructure & DevOps)
General bug analysis without test verification guidance
examples: Please add a parameterized test verifying that negative IDs throw an InvalidArgumentException.
This mock returns null by default; make sure we assert the timeout behavior.

categories.name: Performance & Optimization
categories.definition: Feedback targeting execution latency, algorithmic time/space complexity, memory allocation, caching strategies, resource leaks, and async concurrency throughput.
inclusion_criteria: O(N) to O(1) lookup optimizations and data structure efficiency
Memory leak avoidance, heap allocation reductions, buffer reuse
Caching mechanisms, batch processing, and async execution efficiency
exclusion_criteria: Code readability improvements that do not affect runtime efficiency
Database indexing discussions specifically categorized under Data Management
examples: Using a HashSet here will reduce this lookup from O(N^2) to O(N).
Avoid allocating a new byte buffer on every incoming packet to prevent GC pressure.

categories.name: Security & Privacy
categories.definition: Feedback identifying vulnerabilities, injection attacks, improper authentication/authorization, cryptographic issues, token leaks, and input sanitization.
inclusion_criteria: Input sanitization, XSS, SQL injection, and buffer overflow prevention
Authentication, authorization, JWT tokens, and credential management
Cryptographic best practices, secure random generation, CSRF protection
exclusion_criteria: General null check validation not tied to a security vector (Bug Fixing / Logic)
examples: This raw SQL query concatenates user input; use parameterized binding to prevent SQL injection.
Ensure the session token is marked HttpOnly and Secure.

categories.name: Data Management & Storage
categories.definition: Feedback concerning databases, SQL queries, ORM mapping, schema migrations, indexing, serialization/deserialization (JSON/protobuf), and transactional consistency.
inclusion_criteria: Database queries, indexing, N+1 query prevention, ORM usage
Data schema migrations, column constraints, and foreign keys
Data serialization, schema validation, and persistence lifecycle
exclusion_criteria: In-memory caching without persistence layer interaction (Performance & Optimization)
examples: This query causes an N+1 select; please use `includes(:author)` to eager load records.
Add a unique index constraint on the `user_email` column in this migration.

categories.name: Infrastructure & DevOps
categories.definition: Feedback regarding containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), build systems, CI/CD workflows, deployment automation, monitoring, and environment configuration.
inclusion_criteria: Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, Dockerfiles, and container configs
GitHub Actions workflows, build scripts (Gradle/CMake/Bazel), and CI matrix
Logging, metrics, tracing, and telemetry setup
exclusion_criteria: Individual application unit test assertions (Testing & Quality Assurance)
examples: Update the Dockerfile multi-stage build to strip build dependencies from the final image.
Add a health check liveness probe to this Kubernetes deployment YAML.

categories.name: Frontend, UI & Client-Side
categories.definition: Feedback focused on user interface components, client-side rendering (React/Flutter/DOM), CSS styling, state management, animations, and accessibility.
inclusion_criteria: Widget hierarchy, React hooks, component lifecycle, and DOM manipulation
Responsive styling, layout constraints, CSS/theme definitions
Accessibility (a11y), internationalization, and user input validation
exclusion_criteria: Backend API endpoints serving UI data (Backend / Server-Side)
examples: Wrap this heavy component in `React.memo` and use `useCallback` on the onClick handler.
Ensure this button has an `aria-label` attribute for screen reader accessibility.

categories.name: Documentation & Readability
categories.definition: Feedback requesting docstrings, API reference documentation, README clarifications, comment explanations of complex algorithms, or error message clarity.
inclusion_criteria: Docstrings, Javadoc, godoc, and parameter description improvements
README, migration guides, and developer documentation updates
Clarifying comments on obscure algorithmic logic or edge cases
exclusion_criteria: Formatting changes like line breaks or indentation (Code Style & Formatting)
examples: Please document what exception this method throws when the network times out in the docstring.
Add a brief comment explaining why we bitwise shift by 4 here.

categories.name: Code Style & Formatting
categories.definition: Feedback on code conventions, naming rules, formatting, idiomatic language idioms, linter warnings, dead code removal, and stylistic consistency.
inclusion_criteria: Variable/function naming conventions and casing (camelCase vs snake_case)
Indentation, line length, import ordering, and formatting compliance
Dead/unreachable code cleanup and trivial syntactic sugar
examples: Nit: rename `usr_mgr` to `userManager` to follow repository naming guidelines.
Sort these imports alphabetically and remove the unused `os` import.

categories.name: Bug Fixing & Algorithmic Logic
categories.definition: Feedback detecting logical flaws, off-by-one errors, unhandled null/nil pointers, incorrect return values, race conditions, or faulty control flow.
inclusion_criteria: Null/nil dereference warnings and unhandled edge case branches
Off-by-one errors, infinite loops, and broken conditionals
Incorrect error propagation and unhandled exceptions
exclusion_criteria: Broad architectural restructuring without explicit bug resolution
examples: If `user` is nil here, this line will panic. Please add a nil check before accessing `.ID`.
The loop index should be `<=` rather than `<` to include the final buffer chunk.
